tools.description: Lists every country and region Slashtel sells travel data eSIMs for (about 200 destinations), returning each destination's code, name, lowest live price in USD and number of plans. Use it to find the destination code when the user names a place, a region such as Europe or Asia, or is unsure what is

tools.name: get_esim_plans
tools.description: Live travel eSIM plans for one destination: data (GB), validity (days), price (USD) and price per GB. Use an ISO-2 country code (e.g. TR, JP, US, GB) or a destination code from list_esim_destinations. Optional filters narrow the list.

tools.name: get_topup_plans
tools.description: Detects the operator of a mobile number and returns the live top-up options for it: what the recipient receives, validity where it applies, and the price in USD. The number must include the country code, e.g. +911234567890.

tools.name: create_checkout_link
tools.description: Returns a slashtel.com link with the chosen eSIM plan or top-up already selected. Share it with the user: they enter their email and pay on the site. For type 'esim' pass plan_id. For type 'topup' pass phone, operator_code and send_value from get_topup_plans.

tools.name: check_esim_status
tools.description: For a traveller who already bought a Slashtel eSIM: returns data used, data left, plan size, expiry, status (not yet installed, active, used up or expired) and whether automatic top-up (Keep me connected) is on. findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_esim_status · Public sink: create_checkout_link, check_esim_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_esim_status · Public sink: create_checkout_link, check_esim_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_esim_destinations" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Countries and regions Slashtel sells travel eSIMs for, with the lowest live price (USD) and number of plans. Optional search text filters by name." → after: "Lists every country and region Slashtel sells travel data eSIMs for (about 200 destinations), returning each destination's code, name, lowest live price in USD and number of plans. findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
